methods.fetch_earth_engine: Sentinel-2 NDVI masked with the satellite's own cloud flags, zonal mean per field, weekly median of clear images, linear gap filling, Savitzky-Golay smoothing; CHIRPS rain, ERA5-Land temperature, SMAP soil moisture, Sentinel-1 water.
methods.crop_calendar: Stage from days since sowing with crop-specific stage lengths; if sowing is unknown, phenology: green-up at 20% of the seasonal NDVI range, back-dated by the typical emergence time. Each stage has a weight (flowering = 1.0).
methods.anomalies: Per-field weekly climatology over 21 seasons (mean, sd, p10, p90); z-score and percentile rank; SPI-30/60/90 from a gamma fit with a zero-rain probability; soil moisture percentile.
methods.stress: Rule-based perils (drought cascade, excess water, frost, heat, hail); heat during an active drought is the hot-dry form of that drought (heat x 1.3, attributed to drought); perils combine as independent damage shares (1 - product of (1 - weight x intensity)), so they never add past the scale; intensity x stage weight accumulated with exponential decay (half-life 4 weeks) into a 1-99 score (soft ceiling above 75, never exactly 0 or 100); levels are fixed score bands (Normal 1-24, Watch 25-44, High 45-69, Severe 70-99); confidence = indicator agreement x location quality x cloud-free share.
methods.analogs: Euclidean distance between this season's anomaly series to date (NDVI z, SPI-60, soil percentile) and each history season over the same weeks; the 3 closest seasons and their yield anomalies.
methods.yield_impact: Per region x crop: OLS (p50) and quantile regression (p10, p90) of department yield anomaly on season stress indicators; leave-one-year-out validation; weekly prediction from indicators available to date, wider before sowing.
methods.ifrs9: logit(PD) = logit(PD_orig) + beta x yield loss; Stage 2 on a critical alert or PD >= 2x origination, Stage 3 on BCRA situacion >= 3 or > 90 days past due; LGD x (1 - insurance cover share) with collateral adjustment; EAD from the amortization schedule; ECL = sum of marginal PD x LGD x EAD x DF monthly (12 months for Stage 1, lifetime for Stage 2/3; Stage 2 on short crop loans adds one year of assumed restructuring term); scenarios base/adverse/severe 60/25/15.
methods.portfolio: Weekly totals by level and stage; DBSCAN (haversine, 60 km, min 3) clusters of High/Severe loans; concentration by region and crop; historical-simulation stress test of today's book through the 21 history seasons (p95 = 1-in-20-year loss).
methods.fhi: Crop Health Index (CHI v1, Sviana technical note): per field and 8-day calendar slot, percentiles against this field's own past record in slots j-1..j+1 of the other years for vegetation V (MODIS NDVI), soil S (SMAP soil moisture, two-sided: above the 85th percentile it falls linearly to 0 at the 100th, for waterlogging) and water adequacy W (min(1, ET/PET)); CHI = mean of the available components (>= 2; partial with 2) while the crop is in the ground (field sowing to harvest, else Oct-Apr summer / Jun-Dec winter crops). Bands: >= 60 above normal, 40-60 normal, 25-40 stressed, 10-25 severely stressed, < 10 extreme. Season summary with the critical-period mean; standardized factor f_CHI = (CHI - mu_slot) / sigma_slot is published. Shown for context; it does not change PD, staging, ECL or alerts.
methods.alerts: Alerts from level changes between fixed score bands (Watch 25, High 45, Severe 70); template explanations from computed numbers; rule-table recommendations.

meta.note: Provisions follow IFRS 9 (expected credit loss, stages 1-3). PD sensitivities can be calibrated to your own repayment history.
